_notes.prob_min: Minimum calibrated probability. Low-probability combinations are never candidates, however high their expected return
_notes.stale_minutes: Odds older than this (minutes) at decision time make the race undecidable
_notes.max_candidates_per_race: Maximum candidate combinations per race (highest expected return first)
_notes.show_combinations: Combinations shown per race (top probabilities when there is no candidate)
_notes.odds_window_minutes: Fetch odds for races whose deadline is within this many minutes
_notes.odds_after_close_minutes: Within this many minutes after the deadline, fetch closing odds (verification)
